json_schema.title: file.restore_backup
json_schema.description: Restore a previous version of a file that was backed up using Salt's file state backup system

path.ui:title: Path
path.ui:description: The path on the minion to check for backups

backup_id.ui:title: Backup id
backup_id.ui:description: The numeric id for the backup you wish to restore, as found using file.list_backups
